Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Nitin - 40 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Kavya - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Kavita and Nitin stand near him.]

Nitin: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya throws the ball to Mother.]

Kavita (surprised): "Good job, Aditya!"

[Aditya catches the ball.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Nitin (happily): "One more time!"

[Aditya plays cricket in the park.]

Aditya (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Kavita: "This is amazing!"

[Aditya plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya plays with his dog.]

Aditya (gently): "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Nitin stand near him.]

Aditya: "Dad, look over here."

[Aditya walks across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "That's easy."

[Aditya runs to Mother.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "That was fun!"

[Aditya peeks out from behind the door.]

Aditya: "What a day to remember!"
